S.B. Criminal Misc. Petition No.1023/2015
Pankaj Kumar Rawal & Anr. Vs. State of Rajasthan & Anr.
Date of order : 24.04.2015
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Vijay Bishnoi
Mr. Bhavit Sharma for the petitioners.

This criminal misc. petition under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the petitioners being
aggrieved with the order dated 14.3.2015 whereby the Additional District Magistrate-cum-
Adjudicating Officer, Sirohi has imposed a fine of Rs.50,000/- upon each of the petitioners in the
proceedings under clause (ii) of Sub-Section (2) of Section 26 and Sections 51 and 52 of Food Safety
and Standards Act, 2006.

entities.text: clause (ii) of Sub-Section (2) of Section 26 and Sections 51 and 52
entities.label: PROVISION

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioners has submitted that though the petitioners have submitted their defence before the Adjudicating Officer, but the same has not been considered.
It is contended that as per the report of Food Analyst, the packet of food items do not contain common name or INS number of artificial flavouring substance used in the product.
Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that it was the duty of the manufacturer only to display the common name or INS number on the packed food.
The petitioners are distributors of food items, hence, they cannot be held guilty of commission of any offence.
Learned Public Prosecutor accepts notice on behalf of respondents.
Hence, notice need not be issued.
Meanwhile, the direction given by the Adjudicating Officer vide order dated 14.3.2015 of depositing a fine of Rs.50,000/- to each of the petitioners shall remain stayed.
